sections.heading: Part I — Free-Response Questions (FRQs): Foundational Fluency (1–7)

questions.q: A geometric figure scaled by factor $k = 2$ has an original side length of $4\mathrm{\ cm}$. What is the corresponding image length? Show your complete algebraic work.
questions.target: Degrees, radians, and angles as rotations
questions.answer: Final Answer: $8\mathrm{\ cm}$. Multiplying the original length by the scale factor gives $4 \times 2 = 8\mathrm{\ cm}$.
questions.explanation: Multiplying the original length by the scale factor gives $4 \times 2 = 8\mathrm{\ cm}$.

questions.q: On the coordinate plane, a line with slope $m = 5$ passes through $(0, 9)$. What is its $y$-coordinate when $x = 1$? Show your complete algebraic work.
questions.target: Degrees, radians, and angles as rotations
questions.answer: Final Answer: $14$. Substituting $x = 1$ into $y = 5x + 9$ gives $y = 5(1) + 9 = 14$.
questions.explanation: Substituting $x = 1$ into $y = 5x + 9$ gives $y = 5(1) + 9 = 14$.

questions.q: In $\Delta  ABC$ studying degrees, radians, and angles as rotations, $m\angle A = 35^\circ$ and $m\angle B = 52^\circ$. What is $m\angle C$? Show your complete algebraic work.
questions.target: Degrees, radians, and angles as rotations
questions.answer: Final Answer: $93^\circ$. Using the triangle angle-sum theorem, $m\angle C = 180^\circ - (35^\circ + 52^\circ) = 93^\circ$.
questions.explanation: Using the triangle angle-sum theorem, $m\angle C = 180^\circ - (35^\circ + 52^\circ) = 93^\circ$.

questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 3x + 3$ in trigonometric functions in the coordinate plane, evaluate $f(2)$.
questions.target: Trigonometric functions in the coordinate plane
questions.answer: Final Answer: $9$. Substitute $x = 2$: $f(2) = 3(2) + 3 = 9$.

questions.q: Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 4x + 3 = 0$.
questions.target: Trigonometric functions in the coordinate plane
questions.answer: Final Answer: $x = 1$ and $x = 3$. Factoring $(x - 1)(x - 3) = 0$ yields the roots $x = 1$ and $x = 3$.
questions.explanation: Factoring $(x - 1)(x - 3) = 0$ yields the roots $x = 1$ and $x = 3$.

questions.q: A data set recorded for trigonometric functions in the coordinate plane consists of the four values $\{12, 16, 20, 26\}$. What is the arithmetic mean? Show your complete algebraic work.

questions.answer: Final Answer: $18.5$. The sum is $12 + 16 + 20 + 26 = 74$, and dividing by $4$ gives $18.5$.
